title: hotfix: slo-enforcer regional backoff - prevent thrashing during failover
author: Priya Nandakumar
description:
Summary: Fixes a production bug where the SLO enforcer's backoff state was being reset during regional failover, leading to immediate reopen of circuit-breakers and request thrashing across regions. Root cause: when requests were routed to a failover region the in-memory backoff state in the slo-enforcer pod was not synchronized with the primary region. A failover caused many enforcers to treat the upstream as healthy and immediately remove backoff, causing traffic spikes that thrash downstream capacity.

Changes: 1) Persist backoff state and cooldown windows into the existing distributed config store (kv-config) with a region-scoped key so failover enforcers observe recent backoff and respect cooldown. 2) Introduced hysteresis for backoff removal (require two consecutive healthy windows before clearing backoff) to avoid flip-flop on transient recoveries. 3) Added metric tags (region, failover_reason) for easier post-incident analysis and alerting. 4) Minor rollback guard: if kv-config is unreachable, enforcer falls back to conservative local backoff (longer cooldown) instead of immediate clearing.

Files touched (high level): services/slo-enforcer/enforcer.go, services/slo-enforcer/backoff_store.go, pkg/kvconfig/client.go, pkg/circuitbreaker/backoff_policy.go, tests/integration/slo_enforcer_failover_test.go, deploy/helm/values.yaml, observability/metrics/metrics_registry.go

Testing & verification: Added unit tests for persisted backoff read/write and hysteresis state machine. Integration test simulates primary region outage and assert that failover region maintains backoff for configured cooldown and only clears after two healthy windows. Ran full integration CI and a targeted canary deployment to us-west-2 where we replayed the incident traffic pattern; metrics showed no thrashing and p50/p95 latency remained within SLOs.

Rollback / rollout plan: merge -> auto-build image -> canary in us-west-2 (2 hours of traffic replay) -> gradual rollout to remaining regions over 2h. If kv-config writes fail in canary, we will rollback immediately and open a P1.

Notes: This is a hotfix cherry-pick candidate for the active release branch; create backport PR to release/2026-02 after merge.
commits:
Fix: persist backoff state to kv-config and add hysteresis

- Add backoff_store.go for read/write of region-scoped backoff keys
- Update enforcer.go to consult persistent store before clearing backoff
- Add fallback conservative backoff when kv-config unavailable
- Add and update unit/integration tests
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Please add a short TTL to the region-scoped backoff keys so we don't accumulate stale state across long-term region decommissions. Consider 48h as a starting point.
Author (Priya): Added ttl to backoff_store and documented rationale in code comments; used 48h as recommended.
Jin Park: The hysteresis threshold (2 windows) seems reasonable, but can we make this configurable via helm values?
Author: Exposed hysteresis_windows and default set to 2 in helm values; documented in chart values.
Aisha Rahman: Add a metric for 'backoff_restored_from_persistent_store' to help validate correctness during rollout.
Author: Added metric and tagged by region/failover_reason. CI coverage added for metric emission.
Ops note (Marcus): When backporting to release branch ensure the kv-config client version bump is included to avoid runtime API mismatch.
Author: Updated pkg/kvconfig/client.go and added compatibility tests to catch API mismatch.
Approval: Jin Park approved these changes after tests and TTL added.
Approval: Liam O'Connor approved after review comments addressed.
release_notes: Hotfix: Prevent SLO enforcer backoff state from resetting during regional failover. Adds persistent backoff state, hysteresis for backoff removal, and conservative fallback when kv-config is unavailable. Improves stability during cross-region failovers.
